# City of Boulder

> The official website for the City of Boulder, Colorado, providing comprehensive municipal services, government information, community engagement opportunities, and civic participation resources.

Boulder's municipal website serves as the central hub for residents and visitors to access city services, attend public meetings, stay informed through news and events, and engage with local government. The site emphasizes transparency, community participation, and access to essential city services including utilities, parks, emergency services, and employment opportunities.

## Key Topics

- City Council
- Public Meetings
- City Government
- Community Engagement
- Public Safety
- Boulder Fire-Rescue
- Parks & Recreation
- Water Utilities
- Emergency Response
- Public Participation
- City Departments
- Climate Initiatives
- Municipal Services
- Civic Participation
- News & Updates

## Government & Civic Participation

- [City Council](https://bouldercolorado.gov/government/city-council): City Council members, meetings, and government administration.
- [City Council Meetings](https://bouldercolorado.gov/event-series/city-council): City Council meetings event series and schedule.
- [Participate in City Council Meetings](https://bouldercolorado.gov/services/participate-city-council-meetings): Guide to participating in and attending City Council meetings.
- [Watch City Council Meetings](https://bouldercolorado.gov/government/watch-council-meetings): Instructions for watching City Council meetings online and on TV.
- [Government](https://bouldercolorado.gov/government): City of Boulder government structure, council, and civic participation.

## Core Services & Resources

- [Services](https://bouldercolorado.gov/services): Directory of City of Boulder services including parks, utilities, and resources.
- [Water Utilities](https://bouldercolorado.gov/services/water-utilities): Water utilities billing and customer service portal.
- [Parking](https://bouldercolorado.gov/guide/parking): Parking guide covering permits, rates, and residential programs.
- [Work for the City of Boulder](https://bouldercolorado.gov/work-for-boulder): City of Boulder employment and job opportunities portal.

## Events & Community Engagement

- [Events](https://bouldercolorado.gov/events): Events calendar for City of Boulder municipal events and meetings.
- [Stay Informed](https://bouldercolorado.gov/services/stay-informed): City communications channels including newsletters and social media.

## News & Updates

- [News](https://bouldercolorado.gov/news): News and announcements from City of Boulder departments.
- [City Announces Fund Our Future Community Engagement Opportunities](https://bouldercolorado.gov/news/city-announces-fund-our-future-community-engagement-opportunities): Fund Our Future community engagement and financial strategy announcement.
- [Boulder Fire-Rescue Community Academy Is Back and You Can Apply Now](https://bouldercolorado.gov/news/boulder-fire-rescue-community-academy-back-and-you-can-apply-now): Boulder Fire-Rescue Community Academy application and training program.
- [City of Boulder to Launch Competitive Bid Process to Continue License Plate Reader Technology](https://bouldercolorado.gov/news/city-boulder-launch-competitive-bid-process-continue-license-plate-reader-technology): License plate reader technology contract renegotiation announcement.

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Us](https://bouldercolorado.gov/contact-us): Contact information for City of Boulder departments and offices.
- [Home](https://bouldercolorado.gov): City of Boulder homepage with news, programs, and community resources.

## Optional

- [Projects](https://bouldercolorado.gov/projects): City of Boulder municipal projects directory and infrastructure initiatives.
- [Officer Seriously Injured in Drug Sales Arrest; Suspect given $100 Bond Option](https://bouldercolorado.gov/news/officer-seriously-injured-drug-sales-arrest-suspect-given-100-bond-option): Boulder Police incident report regarding drug sales arrest.
